content: Jovethayeetari atziriite
Iroora Febe aanakerone iroka osankinarentsi. Iro nokempitakaantaa iroomi notsiro. Osheki antavaitake iroori japatotapiintayeetaka janta Cencrea-ki.

Paakameethatavakero iroori, irootake jashitaari eejatzi Avinkatharite, aritzi paakameethatero pikempitapiintziri paakameethatziri pashine itasorentsitakaitairi. Pampitakoyetero ompaityaarika onkovityaayete. Tema osheki ampitakoyetake iroori. Ari okempitakenari naaka eejatzi osheki ampitakoyetakena.
Povethatyaanaro Priscila ipoña Aquila. Irooyetake tsipayetakanari nantavaitziniri Cristo Jesús,
irootake shineventakanari ovavisaakotakena. Osheki nopaasoonketakero irokaite, ari ikempitaayetakero pashinesatzi kaari nosheninkayeta ikaratzi apatoyetapiintachari pashineki nampitsi.
Povethatyaanari eejatzi ikaratzi apatoyetapiintachari opankoki. Povethatyaanari eejatzi netakotane Epeneto, tema iri etanakarori nokempisantakairi Cristo janta Acaya-ki.
Povethatyaanaro María, otzimi antavaiventakemiri osheki eerokaite.

Povethatyaanari Andrónico, ipoña Junias nosheninkapayeeni jinatzi, iri tsipayetakanari jashitakoyeetana. Iriiyetake etakaro ikempisantzitaka tekeramintha naaka, irijatzi jiñaapinkathayetakeri otyaantajanoriite.
Povethatyaanari netakotane Amplias, itzimi jashitaari Avinkatharite.
Povethatyaanari Urbano, itzimi karatapiintakenari nantavaitziniri Cristo Jesús. Povethatyaanari netakotane Estaquis.
Povethatyaanari Apeles, itzimi jaakameethatakeri Cristo. Povethatyaanari maaroiteni itzimi saikavankotziriri Aristóbulo.
Povethatyaanari nosheninka Herodión. Povethatyaanari saikavankotziriri Narciso, ikaratzi inampishiretantaari Avinkatharite.
Povethatyaanaro Trifena, opoña Trifosa. Irootake tsipatakanari nantavaitziniri Avinkatharite. Povethatyaanaro netakotane Pérsida. Irojatzi notsipatakari nantavaitziniri Avinkatharite.
Povethatyaanari Rufo, itzimi jiyoshiitairi Avinkatharite. Povethatyaanaro eejatzi iriniro, otzimi nokempitakaantari naaka iroomi noniro.
Povethatyaanari Asíncrito, Flegonte, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, ipoña ikaratapiintayetziri iriroriite, itzimi apaiyetziri iyekiite.
Povethatyaanari Filólogo, Julia, Nereo ipoña iritsiro, Olimpas, ipoña maaroiteni ikaratzi tsipayetariri iriroriite apaiyetziri itasorentsitakaitane.
Etakora pinkantya povethatavakaanaiya. Jovethayetami eerokaite maaroiteni itzimi apatoventapiintakariri Cristo jaka.
Iyekiite, jiroka nokovakotzimiri: Paamaventyaari ñaanaminthatavakaachari itzimi otzitzikamentavakaarori jiyotaayeetakemiri pairani. Eerora pikempiyayetari eerokaite.

Aña okempivaitakaro atziritanakityeemi “Inevevaitashitane,” iro omperatanakyaarinemi. Tema kaarira Avinkatharite Jesucristo omperayetanaiyaarine. Iriiyetakera nintathayetashitariri eentashireriite jamatavivaitzirira.
Nokemake naakaite kameetha pikantaiyani eerokaite, te pipiyathavaita, irootake oimoshirenkakenari. Nokovi naaka pinkameethashireperote, onkempivaityaaromi te piyoyetaajateromi okantakota kaariperori.

Iriira Pava saikakaayetaimineri kameetha, irootaintsira inkantakaiyaaro pinkitsirinkantyaariri Satanás, onkempivaityaaro povichoryaatyeerimi paatzikakeri. ¡Onkamintha ineshinonkataimi Avinkatharite Jesucristo!
Jovethatami Timoteo, itzimi tsipatanari nantavaitzi, eejatzi nosheninkapayeeni Lucio, Jasón, ipoña Sosípater.
Naakatakera Tercio itzimi osankinayetziniriri Pablo. Naakatake eejatzi ovethatami, naaka jashitayeta eejatzi Avinkatharite.

Jovethatami Gayo. Arira nosaikiri iroñaaka ipankoki. Jovethayetami eejatzi ikaratzi nampiyetarori jaka. Jovethatami Erasto, itzimi oviriri kireeki ashitari nampitsi. Jovethatami eejatzi Cuarto, itzimi apaiyetairi iyeki.
¡Onkamintha ineshinonkayetaimi maaroiteni Avinkatharite Jesucristo! Ari onkantyaari.
Ovekaraantaro tharomentaantsi

Thame antharomentaiyaari iroñaaka matzirori inkempoyaaventayetakemi, ari onkantya pinkyaaryooventapiintantyaarori Kameethari Ñaantsi okaratzi ñaaventakotziriri Jesucristo, tsika otzimi kaari ikemathatapiintayeevetaka pairani.

Iro kantacha, joñaakayeetantaa iroñaaka jiyotaantayeetakera maaroiteni nampitsiki, onkantya inkempisantayeetantyaari eejatzi janta. Irootajaantakera josankinatakaayetakeriri kamantantaneriite irika Pava, Kañaaneri.
Thame antharomentaiyaari apanirotatsiri Pava, Iyotaneri. Tema iriira Jesucristo kantakaiyaarone ankantaitantyaarori antharomentaiyaari. ¡Ari onkantyaari!
